input: Hi! I'm planning my grandmother's 80th birthday lunch. She grew up in Hong Kong, so we'd like dim sum in a private room in North York or Scarborough for 12 people at one table, all sharing one set menu, on a Sunday at 12:00pm three weeks from now. Please make it the luxurious old-school Hong Kong banquet dishes Grandma remembers, nothing modern or fusion. The set should include longevity buns plus a premium signature dish beyond the usual basics, ideally the most indulgent signature dumpling they make. Budget is up to CAD 1,500 total before tax and tip. Could you book the best one? Thank you!

experiences.name: Pearl Court — Grand Longevity Set for 12
experiences.description: Hong Kong banquet-style dim sum featuring our signature Superior Golden Broth Dumpling (灌湯餃), a classic Hong Kong teahouse recipe. Superior Golden Broth Dumpling: one large dumpling per guest in superior chicken broth, filled with pork, shiitake, bamboo shoot and fin-style strands made from konjac and mung bean starch; contains no shark fin. Set for 12 includes har gow, siu mai, char siu bao, steamed rice rolls and longevity buns (壽包). Broth simmered 8 hours in-house; dumplings steamed individually in tureens; private room seats 14; longevity buns made with lotus-seed paste. Sunday lunch seatings from 11am.

experiences.name: Lotus Garden Vegetarian — Buddhist Dim Sum Set for 12
experiences.description: Buddhist vegetarian (全素, no egg or dairy) dim sum for 12: crystal vegetable dumplings, tofu-skin rolls, mushroom siu mai, wheat-gluten char siu-style buns and lotus-seed longevity buns (壽包), with no lard used. Made with wheat gluten, tofu skin and seasonal vegetables; wrappers made with wheat and tapioca starch and water. Round tables seat 12.

experiences.name: Jade Harbour Seafood Restaurant — Golden Celebration Set for 12
experiences.description: A classic Hong Kong teahouse menu starring our famous Treasure Pouch Broth Dumpling, as served at Hong Kong banquets. Treasure Pouch Broth Dumpling: served in superior broth; filling of shredded shark fin, pork and wood ear mushroom set in seafood stock. Set for 12 includes har gow, siu mai, char siu bao, steamed rice rolls and longevity buns (壽包). Dumplings hand-folded each morning and served tableside from a clay tureen; private room for 12; parking on site. Sunday lunch seatings from 11am.

experiences.name: Maple Moon Bakery — Mango-Coconut Longevity Cake
experiences.description: A custom birthday cake for 12: light vegan mango-coconut chiffon finished with hand-piped 壽 calligraphy. Made with coconut cream and aquafaba; mango purée from Ataulfo mangoes. Pickup or same-day delivery across Toronto.

experiences.name: Victoria Peak Dim Sum House — Celebration Banquet Set for 12
experiences.description: A classic Hong Kong teahouse menu with our signature Treasure Broth Dumpling, a Hong Kong banquet favourite. Treasure Broth Dumpling: served in superior broth; filling of pork, dried scallop (conpoy), bamboo pith and wood ear mushroom; contains no shark fin. Set for 12 includes har gow, siu mai, char siu bao, steamed rice rolls and longevity buns (壽包). Dumplings hand-folded each morning and served tableside from a clay tureen; private room for 12; parking on site. Sunday lunch seatings from 11am.

experiences.name: Golden Dragon Palace — Imperial Longevity Set for 12
experiences.description: Hong Kong banquet-style dim sum built around our signature Imperial Golden Broth Dumpling (灌湯餃), a 1970s Hong Kong teahouse classic. Imperial Golden Broth Dumpling: one large dumpling per guest in superior chicken broth, filled with shark fin, pork, shiitake and bamboo shoot. Set for 12 includes har gow, siu mai, char siu bao, steamed rice rolls and longevity buns (壽包). Broth simmered 8 hours in-house; dumplings steamed individually in tureens; private room seats 14; longevity buns made with lotus-seed paste. Sunday lunch seatings from 11am.

experiences.name: Mountain Cloud Tea House — Private Hong Kong-Style Afternoon Tea for 12
experiences.description: A private afternoon tea tasting for 12: aged pu'er and oolong poured gongfu-style by a tea master, with plant-based red bean pastries and mango-sago cups. Teas sourced from Yunnan and Fujian; 2-hour booking in a quiet private room.
